subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or adopt the open conflicting fork PR before authorizing a fresh narrow OpenClaw fix for this Telegram approval deletion bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but this issue is still paired with an open fork PR using closing syntax; automation should not create a competing implementation until that candidate is resolved.

options.title: Close and replace the fork PR
options.body: Close the obsolete conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against the active `approval-handler.runtime.ts` path.

options.title: Adopt the fork branch manually
options.body: A maintainer can rework the fork PR into the active runtime seam, but most of the old handler-path work will need replacement.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the current fork PR, accepting that the issue remains blocked while the fork stays conflicting and stale.

recommendation.title: Close and replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Close the obsolete conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against the active `approval-handler.runtime.ts` path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-file history and the cleanup-routing decision make this the best available owner for resolving the linked fork PR state.
